summary: title: Amazon Nova Act tags: coding-agent, cloud, aws, amazon, agent-orchestration # Amazon Nova Act AWS service for building and managing fleets of AI agents to automate production UI workflows. ## Overview - Developer : Amazon Web Services (AWS) - Interface : AWS service + IDE extension - Pricing : AWS service pricing (TBD) - Launch : Research preview → GA December 2, 2025 ## Key Capabilities - Agent Fleet Management : Build and manage fleets of agents for production UI workflows - High Reliability : Designed for production-grade reliability with fast time-to-value - Ease of Implementation at Scale : Streamlined agent building process - IDE Extension : Dedicated IDE extension to streamline the agent building process - Production UI Workflows : Specialized in automating UI-based production workflows ## History - Research Preview : Initially launched as a research preview - IDE Extension : Later introduced an IDE extension to streamline the agent building process - General Availability (Dec 2, 2025) : Nova Act became generally available as a service on AWS for building and managing highly reliable AI agents at scale ## Competitive Positioning - Positioned as an enterprise-grade agent orchestration service on AWS - Focuses on production reliability and scale rather than developer experience - Complements existing AWS AI services (Bedrock, Q) - Competes directly with [[openai]] and [[anthropic]] in the AI agent space - Competes with multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) in the enterprise space - Unique focus on UI workflow automation distinguishes from code-centric agents ## Related - [[openai]] — Models available on Amazon Bedrock - [[anthropic]] — Claude models available on Amazon Bedrock - [[google-gemini]] — Gemini models available on AWS
